versions.content: Dem can directly access dataElement s in PPortProto- type s typed by a SenderReceiverInterface An exception to the rule described in [constr_2019] applies: the Dem can directly access dataElement s in Abstract- ProvidedPortPrototype s typed by a SenderReceiverInterface . For this purpose, the ServiceSwComponentType that represents the Dem function- ality can have RPortPrototype s typed by a compatible SenderReceiverInter- face that may set isService to FALSE .
